2. the driver of unit 1 did not see unit 2 due to the fact that he was focused on the child that ran out in front of his vehicle. after unit 1 barley struck unit 2, it made unit 2 fall to the ground intersection. in the parking lot of this store toward the roadway is a dumpster that is surrounded by a wood fence. the driver of unit 1 advised, that unit 2 was carrying grocery bags and appeared as did not cross the intersection in the crosswalk. if unit two was at the corner of the intersection on the sidewalk and was crossing in the marked crosswalk the driver of unit 1 would have seen unit 2 surrounding the dumpster had partially blocked his view and he was not expecting anyone to come out in the roadway not in the crosswalk. impact occurred west of the crosswalk. there was no damage done records.deidentified_narrative: the 10765 block of kenworthy is albertsons private parking lot. unit 1 struck pedestrian on the right shoulder with the front right side of the vehicle while traveling east on the parking lot. unit 1 stated that he did not see the pedestrian and did not recall sticking her with his vehicle, until she approached him in the parking lot and began yelling at him. pedestrian was transported to sierra providence northeast where officers followed up. officers were advised by medical staff that pedestrian did not sustain life threatening injuries only minor scrapes. witness stated that she saw the pedestrian on the floor, however, she was able to get up and walked towards unit 1. there was no damage to unit 1, and no citations were issued. pedestrian advised that she wanted a report completed of the incident. officers gave pedestrian an incident card with [case id] and advised the report would be completed. it should be noted that the collision occurred in the albertsons parking lot. [date]- unit 2 pedestrian holly lytle had requested to be contacted to discuss discrepancies with this crash report. lieutenant jaime velasquez #996 contact her via telephone.
